name: open-pdf-studio
description: A free, open-source PDF annotation editor built with Tauri

scripts.predev: npm run prepare:native-runtime && cargo build -p pdfium-worker
scripts.prebuild: npm run prepare:native-runtime && cargo build --release -p pdfium-worker
scripts.test: npm run test:ocr && npm run test:unit && npm run test:quality
scripts.test:ocr: node --test js/ocr/contracts/v1.test.mjs js/ocr/contracts/production.test.mjs js/ocr/searchable-layer.test.mjs js/ocr/application-controller.test.mjs js/ocr/cache.test.mjs js/ocr/model-state.test.mjs js/ocr/engine.test.mjs js/ocr/child-runner.test.mjs js/ocr/paddleocr/adapter.test.mjs js/ocr/paddleocr/postprocess.test.mjs js/ocr/pdf-writer-proof.test.mjs js/ocr/pdf-persistence.test.mjs scripts/ocr-assets.test.mjs scripts/evaluate-ocr-phase-a-reports.test.mjs scripts/evaluate-ocr-phase-a-macos-report.test.mjs scripts/ocr-process-attribution.test.mjs scripts/ocr-build-kind.test.mjs scripts/ocr-quality-benchmark.test.mjs
scripts.test:unit: node --test scripts/test-nen-ifc-map.mjs scripts/test-systeemraster.mjs js/drafting/tekeningtype.test.mjs js/annotations/editable-numbers.test.mjs js/symbols/templates/wapeningskorf.test.mjs js/pdf/progressive-render.test.mjs js/pdf/tile-coverage.test.mjs js/quantities/engine.test.mjs js/quantities/schedule-image.test.mjs js/quantities/takeoff.test.mjs js/text/text-edit-appearance.test.mjs js/tools/embedded-image-parser.test.mjs
scripts.test:quality: node --test scripts/native-runtime.test.mjs scripts/release-config.test.mjs scripts/linux-release-config.test.mjs scripts/pdfium-sidecar.test.mjs scripts/square-image-annotation.test.mjs
